samples.name: item-stone
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Single isolated inventory sprite for a cozy medieval Slavic village RPG. Both attached sheets are style references only: match the simple Kenney Tiny Farm / Tiny Town pixel art. Tiny 16x16 logical pixel icon enlarged to 1024x1024; each logical pixel a solid square, extremely sparse detail and large clear pixel clusters. Single centered silhouette, 1 logical pixel margin. Top-down three-quarter view showing top and south-facing front, not isometric. Warm earthy restricted palette, at most 3 flat shades per material, darker local-color outlines, upper-left lighting. Truly transparent background. No scenery, ground, shadow, text, label, border, gradient, texture noise, soft edges, antialiasing, realistic detail or pure black outline. Subject: Small pile of three rough grey field stones, one large in front and two smaller behind.
